content: <thought>Based on the high‑resolution mass (m/z 183.045 [M+H]⁺) the neutral mass is ≈ 182.038 Da, which matches the formula C₉H₁₀O₄ (exact mass 182.0579 Da, within typical HRMS error). The ¹³C NMR shows nine distinct carbons: a carbonyl (~169 ppm), six aromatic carbons, and an ethyl ester fragment (CH₂ ≈ 43 ppm, CH₃ ≈ 26 ppm). This pattern is consistent with an ethyl dihydroxybenzoate (an ethyl ester of a di‑hydroxybenzoic acid). A valid SMILES for this structure is **CCOC(=O)c1ccc(O)cc1O**. This SMILES contains 9 carbons and 4 oxygens, matching the inferred formula and the observed spectroscopic data.
